English.Char_Desc_45: Finds photos and documents two folders share
English.Char_Desc_80: Finds matching photos and documents in two folders, even renamed or resized.
English.Char_Desc_250: Choose Folder A and Folder B, then compare. Photos that look the same (even resized or re-saved) and documents with the same words are listed side by side with previews. Nothing is moved or deleted; the list can be saved for Excel.
English.Char_Desc_450: Choose Folder A and Folder B, then compare. Photos that look the same (even resized or re-saved) and documents with the same words are listed side by side with previews. Nothing is moved or deleted; the list can be saved for Excel. Free. Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit; nothing else to install.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
Cross Folder Compare finds the photos and documents that two folders have in common, even when the copies have different names, sizes or formats. Click 1. Choose Folder A, 2. Choose Folder B, then 3. Compare the two folders. Photos match when they look the same, even if one was resized or re-saved (JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, WebP). Word, OpenDocument, RTF, PDF and text files match when they share the same words; formatting is ignored. Click a row to see both files side by side with a picture or text preview. Show matches at least 95%, 90%, 85% or 80% changes the list instantly. Save list to CSV opens in Excel. Nothing is moved or deleted: the program only reads your files.
Before you install: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The installer is not code-signed (a signing certificate is a paid yearly service), so Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box: click More info, then Run anyway. A few antivirus programs wrongly flag new unsigned programs; you can check the download against the SHA-256 fingerprint on its release page. No administrator password is needed.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: Cross Folder Compare is free to use and share. Download sites may list it and offer the unchanged Setup.exe, or link to the download page.
Permissions.EULA: Cross Folder Compare is free and comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk. The free parts it is built from keep their own licenses, listed in the licenses folder it installs.
